# About ITE

ITE was established as a post-secondary institution in 1992, under the Ministry of Education, Singapore.

Last updated 8 October 2025

The Institute of Technical Education (ITE) was established as a post-secondary institution in 1992, under the Ministry of Education. ITE is a principal provider of career and technical education and a key developer of national skills certification and standards, skilling Singapore for the future economy. It offers three key programmes:

- Pre-Employment Training for youths after secondary education,
- Continuing Education and Training for adult learners, and
- Workplace Learning and Work-Study Programmes with employers.

Under its 'One ITE System, Three Colleges' Governance Model, ITE has three Colleges - ITE College Central, ITE College East and ITE College West.

## Mission

To Create Opportunities for Students and Adult Learners to Acquire Skills, Knowledge and Values for Employability and Lifelong Learning

## Vision

Globally Distinguished Institution for Skills and Careers Development

## Values

***ITE Care*****– I**ntegrity**| T**eamwork**| E**xcellence**| Care**

# Key milestones

Key milestones in ITE's transformation.

Last updated 27 August 2025

The Institute of Technical Education (ITE) was established as a post-secondary institution, under the Ministry of Education (MOE), to take over the functions of the Vocational and Industrial Training Board (VITB) in April 1992.

Since then, ITE has transformed itself to become the principal provider of Career and Technical Education in Singapore. We continue to strive for excellence and became the first Education Institution to win the Singapore Quality Award (SQA) in 2005 and the SQA (with Special Commendation) (SQA SC) in 2011. In 2018, we became one of only two Public Agencies to receive the SQA SC for a second time.

In 2022, we celebrated our 30-year journey of ‘Inspiration, Transformation and Excellence’, and we launched our 7th strategic plan, *ITE Elevate*, in 2025.

Learn more about ITE’s Transformation Journey below.

# Global partnerships

In line with our vision to be a global leader, we form extensive partnerships with renowned institutions globally. Today, we have over 40 partner institutions in 14 countries.

Last updated 27 August 2025

### [International consultancy & training](/about-ite/our-organisation/global-partnerships/international-consultancy---training/)

### [International visitors](/about-ite/our-organisation/global-partnerships/international-visitors/)

In line with our vision to be a global leader, we form extensive partnerships with renowned institutions globally. Today, we have over 40 partner institutions in 14 countries. # Our subsidiaries

There are four subsidiaries under ITE's purview.

Last updated 27 August 2025

There are four subsidiaries under ITE's purview, namely:

- **ITE Education Services Pte Ltd**, set up in January 2003 with the objective of sharing ITE's expertise in Technical and Vocational Education & Training;
- **NorthLight School**, for students who have attempted the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) and are assessed not suitable to progress to Secondary School education or to re-attempt the PSLE; and
- Specialised Schools for Normal (Technical) students, **Crest Secondary School**and **Spectra Secondary School**

# ITE Academic Advisory Committees

The ITE Academic Advisory Committees (AACs) are set up to examine and approve the syllabuses of courses for the respective industries or occupational clusters.

Last updated 6 May 2026

The ITE **Academic Advisory Committees (AACs**) are set up to examine and approve the syllabuses of courses for the respective industries or occupational clusters. The 7 AACs meet regularly to discuss and review the syllabuses, provide feedback on changes in industry, as well as provide specialist advice on technological trends. Each AAC comprises employer representatives, professionals and specialists from the respective industries.

# About College Central

Discover the vibrant campus life at ITE College Central.

Last updated 22 December 2025

Welcome to ITE College Central, where creativity and innovation flourish in a unique learning environment. With four Schools - Business Services, Electronics & Info-Comm Technology, Engineering, and Design & Media - offering a variety of courses, there is something for everyone. Dive into authentic learning experiences at our state-of-the-art facilities, which includes a Boeing 737, early childhood education centre, sound stage for performances, and a ship hull workshop. Through our strong partnerships with global and industry leaders, you will be equipped with the right skills for success!

# Important information for graduands (ITE College Central)

Congratulations on your graduation! Please help us make your graduation ceremony a success by observing the instructions below.

Last updated 11 June 2026

All attendees (graduands and guests) **must register** to attend the graduation ceremony.

## Timeline of events

Timeline and details of events

| Dates | Event |
| --- | --- |
| Wednesday, 8 Apr 2026 | E-Invitation via ITE EmailGraduands will receive the invitation to register for the graduation ceremony via their ITE and personal email addresses declared in our system. |
| Wednesday, 8 Apr 2026, 10am – Sunday, 19 Apr 2026, 11.59pm | Online RegistrationConfirm your attendance online regardless of whether you are attending the graduation ceremony.Refer to the Schedule of Ceremonies section for the date of your graduation sessions.The Online Registration System will be open for registration fromWednesday 8 Apr 2026, 10:00am till Sunday 19 Apr 2026, 11:59pm.Please log in to the registration site using yourITE email address (e.g.xxx@connect.ite.edu.sgfor full-time graduates) or your personal email address registered with ITE (for part-time graduates). A One-Time Pin (OTP) will be sent to the provided email address for login during the registration process.Click the link below to register:Graduate Online RegistrationGraduands attending the ceremony are welcome to inviteup to 2 guests to grace the event. Only registered graduands and guests will be admitted into the venue.As a courtesy to other guests, we regret that childrenbelow the age of 6 yearswill not be allowed into the Auditorium. One child is considered asone (1) guest.Graduands who fail to register their attendance bySunday, 19 Apr 2026, 11:59pmwill be deemed as not attending and will not be admitted into the venue. Please note that due to limitation in seat allocation, walk-in attendees who did not register their attendance may not be accommodated to attend the ceremony. |
| Monday, 20 Apr 2026 - Wednesday, 22 Apr 2026 | Graduation Gown RentalPlease refer to Gown Rental section for details on graduation gown rental and dress code for the graduation ceremony.Note: The graduation gown rental dates onMonday, 20 Apr 2026 - Wednesday, 22 Apr 2026are in ITE College Central. You may also check the other dates in other colleges via the Gown Rental section. |
| Now | Clearance of Fees/ Fines/ LoansGraduands are to ensure that all outstanding fees [i.e. school fees, library fines etc.] are fully paid and properties on loan [library books, equipment etc.] are returned byFriday, 24 Apr 2026, 6:00pm.Graduands with outstanding feeswill not be allowedto collect their certificates during the Graduation Ceremony. |
| During Graduation Ceremony | Certificates & TranscriptsThe hardcopy Graduation Certificate and Transcript will be given out during the ceremony.Graduands who are unable to attend the ceremony may contact the ITE Customer & Visitor Centre at 1800 222 2111 to make an appointment to collect your certificate and transcriptfrom Monday, 25 May 2026.Certificates which are uncollected will be destroyed after 1 year from the date of issuance and will not be re-issued.Digital Certificates & TranscriptsGraduates may also retrieve your digital certificates / academic transcripts issued by ITE afterFriday, 15 May 2026by logging in toMySkillsFutureportal with your SingPass.Find out how you can access your Digital Certificateshere. |

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can I attend the graduation ceremony if I do not have the graduation attire?
No. All graduands, including those who are serving NS, must be in the graduation attire before they can be presented on stage.What is the dress code or attire for the graduation ceremony?
Please refer to  [Gown Rental & Dress Code](/about-ite/colleges/college-central/college-central-graduation/gown-rental-and-dress-code/)  for more details.If I am not able to attend the graduation ceremony, can I get my friend to collect the certificate for me at the ceremony?
No. If you are unable to attend the graduation ceremony, you may collect your certificate at the ITE College Central Customer & Visitor Centre from **Monday, 25 May 2026** onwards during office hours **(Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm).**

Please book an appointment online via  [queue.ite.edu.sg/book-appointment/NjUw](https://queue.ite.edu.sg/book-appointment/NjUw)  before coming down. **Kindly bring along your NRIC or student pass for verification purposes.**

Certificates that remain uncollected will be destroyed after 1 year from the date of issuance and will not be re-issued.I have registered my attendance online and would like to amend my submission. What should I do?
Please email  [**cc_graduation@ite.edu.sg**](mailto:cc_graduation@ite.edu.sg) to amend your online registration before closure of the online registration on **Sunday, 19 Apr 2026 at 11.59pm**. Strictly no amendment requests can be made after **Sunday, 19 Apr 2026**.What happens if I do not receive the One-Time Pin (OTP) after keying in my ITE email address (for full-time graduates) or personal email address registered with ITE (for part-time graduates)?
Please kindly check your junk email box for the OTP email.Can I collect my certificate before the graduation ceremony?
No, all graduands will collect their certificate only after the graduation ceremony.Will there be an official photographer to take photographs of the graduands?
Yes, an official photographer will take a photograph of graduands as they are on stage to receive their certificates. Each graduand will be issued a personal link within 1 week from the event to download their photograph.Can I collect my certificate if I have unpaid fees?
No, you will not be able to collect your certificate after the graduation ceremony if you have any unpaid fees. So, do ensure you have paid all your fees by **Friday, 24 Apr 2026, 6:00pm.**How many guests can I bring?
Graduand is allowed to invite **up to 2 guests** to attend the graduation ceremony in college.

Step into ITE College Central, where creativity and innovation shape your learning journey. With four exciting schools—Business Services, Electronics & Info-Comm Technology, Engineering, and Design & Media—there is a course for every passion and interest. ## Guide on choosing the right course

**Pathways to success!**

Whether it's furthering your educational journey or exploring the working world, we have it mapped out for you. Check out the multiple pathways for you to pursue your dreams:

- [Nitec](/secondary-school-students/admissions/academic-progression/academic-progression-from-nitec/)
- [Higher Nitec](/secondary-school-students/admissions/academic-progression/academic-progression-from-full-time-higher-nitec/)

The **Holland Code Test**helps you understand your interest, talent and aptitude for learning.

[Take the test to discover your inclination](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/portal/en/assessment/landing.html) .

Check out the  [infographics [PDF,161 KB]](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/145/5b5005fb-5dc9-4bae-ba53-a5f194aa20d6/riasec.pdf)  to find out the Schools at ITE CC that matches your personality and interests!

If you are a graduating student and would like to be offered a place here with us before taking your GCE N and O Level Exams, you can apply through the **Early Admission Exercise (EAE)**. You will receive a conditional offer for admission to ITE based on your aptitudes and interests.

[EAE FAQ](/secondary-school-students/admissions/early-admissions-exercise/)

**Direct-Entry-Scheme to Polytechnic Programme (DPP)**

Apply for  [DPP](/secondary-school-students/admissions/entry-qualifications/gce-n-level/for-gce-n-students-jie-h/)  to secure your place in a related Polytechnic Diploma course. (You would need to meet the Minimum Entry Requirement (MER) to apply and achieve the qualifying Grade Point Average (GPA) score in your *Higher Nitec* course. DPP is only applicable for Sec 4NA students.)

[DPP FAQ](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/145/dc66c96b-1a33-4a79-aaec-24972992ed6d/JIEH%202026%20Intake%20-JIEH%20WebFAQ_7%20Jan.pdf)

# Business & Services courses & Career prospects

The School of Business and Services (SBS) offers you a focused range of programmes to equip you with the knowledge and skills for the highly mobile, high tech businesses of the ever changing global marketplace.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**New 3-year*****Higher Nitec***

ITE has introduced a new 3-year *Higher Nitec* full-time programme from Academic Year 2022. Streamlining the current *Nitec* and *Higher Nitec* curricula, this new option will allow students to attain a *Higher Nitec* qualification directly, in three years instead of the current four years.

O-Level, N(A) and N(T) students can apply for this new 3-year*Higher Nitec* programme using the existing *Nitec* entry requirements.

O-Level and Direct Entry Scheme to Polytechnic Programme (DPP) N(A) students will join the programme directly in the second year and will continue to attain their *Higher Nitec* in 2 years.

If you are curious to discover the know-how of businesses, would like to master the art of providing good service to customers or keen to develop your entrepreneurial skills, you may just find success at our School of Business and Services (SBS). SBS offers you a focused range of programmes to equip you with the knowledge and skills for the highly mobile, high tech businesses of the ever changing global marketplace. Through well-designed practical training and industry exposure we will put you on a head start in your career path.

# Electronics & Info-Comm Technology courses & Career prospects

Our School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology (SEIT) provides you with opportunities to be that dynamic learner and problem-solver in finding real-world solutions through gaming and exploratory means.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**New 3-year*****Higher Nitec***

ITE has introduced a new 3-year *Higher Nitec* full-time programme from Academic Year 2022. Streamlining the current *Nitec* and *Higher Nitec* curricula, this new option will allow students to attain a *Higher Nitec* qualification directly, in only three years instead of the current four years.

O-Level, N(A) and N(T) students can apply for this new 3-year*Higher Nitec* programme using the existing *Nitec* entry requirements.

O-Level and Direct Entry Scheme to Polytechnic Programme (DPP) N(A) students will join the programme directly in the second year and will continue to attain their *Higher Nitec* in 2 years.

Gaming, Experimenting, Exploring. If you are looking for fun and experimental ways of learning, our School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology (SEIT) is the right choice for you.Through the adoption of the Play. Learn. Build teaching and learning model, SEIT provides you with opportunities to be that dynamic learner and problem-solver in finding real-world solutions through gaming and exploratory means. Hone your skills and technical knowledge in electronics systems and tools, and the working of new technologies for an exciting career with the Electronics and ICT Industry.

# Engineering courses & Career prospects

The School of Engineering at ITE College Central offers programmes that are designed to meet the changing needs of the engineering industry, offering you the chance to grow and develop your skills.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**New 3-year*****Higher Nitec***

ITE has introduced a new 3-year *Higher Nitec* full-time programme from Academic Year 2022. Streamlining the current *Nitec* and *Higher Nitec* curricula, this new option will allow students to attain a *Higher Nitec* qualification directly, in only three years instead of the current four years.

O-Level, N(A) and N(T) students can apply for this new 3-year*Higher Nitec* programme using the existing *Nitec* entry requirements.

O-Level and Direct Entry Scheme to Polytechnic Programme (DPP) N(A) students will join the programme directly in the second year and will continue to attain their *Higher Nitec* in 2 years.

Innovate and explore with the School of Engineering. If you are inspired by innovation and excited to create new inventions, the School of Engineering at ITE College Central is the place for you. Our programmes are designed to meet the changing needs of the engineering industry, offering you the chance to grow and develop your skills. With hands-on training and real-world experience, you will be well-equipped to take on exciting engineering challenges.

# Other facilties

Check out our student related, general and retail facilities at ITE College Central.

Last updated 6 July 2026

## Centre for Music & The Arts (CeMTA)

### (Blk B Level 4)

CeMTA functions to promote and showcase students’ performing and visual arts talents across ITE Colleges. CeMTA’s diverse arts platforms provide accessibility to different genres of art forms, catering to artistic and popular interests of the ITE community as well as public.CeMTA’s recital and dance studios are also used for Curriculum & Elective Courses for the School of Design & Media in the areas of performance production and Performing Arts, rehearsal space and Co-Curricular Activity (CCA).

## Experience ITE Centre

### (Blk A Level 3)

The Experience ITE Centre (EIC) is designed to introduce Secondary 2G1 and Secondary 3G2 / Normal Academic students to the diverse courses and training opportunities available at ITE College Central. Through hands-on activities and interactive learning, students can explore, discover, and gain valuable insights into their potential future pathways.

As a dedicated facility for the Experience ITE Programme (EIP), the EIC serves as the first official touchpoint for these students, many of whom will be experiencing ITE for the first time. During their visit, participants will engage in four hands-on activities and embark on a guided tour of the college’s state-of -the-art training facilities, offering them an immersive introduction to ITE’s dynamic learning environment at College Central.

## Student Activity Centre

### (Blk D Level 4)

**Opening hours: Mon to Fri (9.00am to 5.00pm)**

The Student Activity Centre (SAC) is a vibrant informal learning area managed by the ITE College Central’s Student Council. It is a place for students to gather, play, learn or collaborate. Students are welcome to book various types of facilities and equipment such as meeting rooms, foosball tables, board games and Xbox 360 Kinect, which aims to promote student interaction and discussion.

## Student Care@Central

### (Blk A Level 3)

**Opening hours: Mon - Fri (8.30am to 5.30pm)**

**Email:** [**whatsup@ite.edu.sg**](mailto:whatsup@ite.edu.sg)

Student Care@Central is a professional counselling centre that attends to the students' psychological, social, developmental and learning needs. The centre provides holistic services to the students and staff of ITE College Central and a conducive place for individual and group counselling, talks and workshops and learning support for students.

## Student Services Centre

### (Blk A Level 3)

**Opening hours: Mon - Thu (9.00am to 6.00pm) / Fri (8.30am to 5.30pm)**

The Student & Career Services Centre provides a convenient one-stop service point for students to obtain information and services related to Student Services such as Financial Assistance & Computer Subsidy, ITE Student Concession Card, Student Locker & College Blazer Loan, Student Guidance Advising as well as Education & Career Guidance counselling matters.

# School of Business & Services

Come and explore the key facilities at our School of Business and Services.

Last updated 6 July 2026

If you are curious to discover the know-how of businesses, would like to master the art of providing good service to customers or keen to develop your entrepreneurial skills, you may just find success at our School of Business and Services.

The School of Business and Services offers you a focused range of programmes to equip you with the knowledge and skills for the highly mobile, high tech businesses of the ever changing global marketplace. Through well-designed practical training and industry exposure we will put you on a head start in your career path.

## Aviation Hub (Passenger Services)

### (Blk G Level 2)

The Aviation Hub (Passenger Services) is a purpose-built training facility at ITE College Central that replicates a real-world airport environment. Students gain hands-on experience in key passenger handling functions, including check-in, boarding, arrivals, transit operations, and crisis response, using industry-aligned systems that mirror modern passenger terminals.

Immersive Mixed Reality (MR) simulations, together with industry-grade systems such as self-check-in kiosks, bag-drop machines with facial recognition, and departure control systems, enable students to practise in realistic scenarios. This integrated approach builds confidence, professionalism, and operational readiness, preparing graduates to deliver safe, efficient, and seamless passenger experiences in today’s aviation industry.

## Early Childhood Training Centre

### (Blk J Level 2)

The Early Childhood Education Labs are purpose-built spaces that simulate real childcare environments, supporting hands-on learning across teaching, play, and activity planning. Designed for flexibility, the labs can be adapted for lessons, discussions, indoor play, and collaborative projects, ensuring a dynamic and practical learning experience for students.

Key facilities include the Music and Drama Lab, featuring an elevated stage, flexible seating, and a treehouse loft for performances, group work, and reflection. The Art and Exploration Lab support art, numeracy, and exploratory learning, with dedicated areas for creative work, hygiene practices, and nutrition activities. Cookery and art corners further enhance training, enabling students to design meals and learning experiences that support young children’s development.

## Retail Training Centre

### (Blk D Level 3)

The Retail Training Centre offers a realistic retail environment where students apply skills from the curriculum in hands-on settings. It incorporates technology-enabled solutions such as smart trolleys, live streaming and RFID-based cashless, queueless shopping to reflect current industry practices and enhance customer experience.

To nurture entrepreneurial skills, the Centre features the ‘Concept Shelf’, a platform for student-led micro-enterprises. Students curate, brand and market product collections—including sustainable thrifted goods—while managing the full retail process. This builds capabilities in business agility, product curation and value-driven retail strategies.

## Human Performance Lab

### (Blk J Level 3)

The Human Performance Lab (HPL) supports training in exercise, sports, and health sciences, preparing students for roles such as sports coaches and fitness trainers.

Equipped with industry-standard tools for anthropometric and fitness assessments, the lab enables comprehensive human performance analysis. Students gain hands-on experience with advanced testing technologies while developing research, evaluation, and analytical skills relevant to the sports and fitness industry.

## PE iLab

### (Blk F Level 3)

The PE Indoor Lab is a flexible, modular learning space designed to support innovative Physical Education teaching and training. Its adaptable layout enables educators to pilot new concepts and programmes that challenge motor skills and enhance student engagement.

Equipped with screen sharing and video analysis technology, the lab supports active learning and peer observation. Students develop physical literacy through improved movement efficiency, coordination, and neuromuscular control, contributing to better overall performance in sports and physical activities.

## National Education Hub

### (Blk E Level 4)

The National Education (NE) Hub at ITE College Central is an interactive space with multiple zones that engage students and visitors while showcasing Singapore’s history, including ITE and Ang Mo Kio. It fosters a sense of belonging and national identity and serves as a central venue for heritage and NE-related activities.

Visitors enter through a student-created in collab with Mr Yip Yew Cheong, mural celebrating local culture, followed by themed zones representing the past, present and community life. Highlights include a kopitiam and kampong setting, a wellness-focused reflection area, and a green space inspired by HDB and MRT elements. The Hub concludes with a classroom-style zone designed for learning, collaboration and exploration.

## InvITE

### (Blk K Level 2)

invITE is a purpose-built learning space for Work-Study Diploma students in Community Development & Engagement, Event Management, and Lifestyle & Recreation Management. It supports authentic, immersive learning where students design and deliver meaningful programmes, apply digital technologies, build industry-relevant skills, and collaborate with partners.

The space features three zones aligned to the learning journey—Explore, Experience, and Synthesis. The Digital Wall supports digital exploration and data-driven insights, Nosy Nook enables hands-on creation of user-centric, hybrid experiences, and Common Hood provides a collaborative environment for refining ideas, peer evaluation, and industry engagement, supported by live-streaming and digital tools.

## FITLAB

### (Blk K Level 5)

FITLAB is a 450 sqm, state-of-the-art learning facility designed to support hands-on training for the Sport Management course. Equipped with advanced health assessment tools and AI-enabled technologies, it prepares students for the evolving fitness and sports industry, with a focus on holistic health, data-driven practice, and client-centred services. Learning is guided by a structured “Experience, Explore, Connect” approach, enabling students to build practical skills, think critically, and apply knowledge in real-world contexts.

Key features include advanced health assessment equipment for personalised training and an AI-powered motion capture system for real-time movement analysis. Together, these tools equip students with industry-relevant skills, preparing them for careers in health, fitness, and sports.

## Security Operations Training Centre

### (Blk J Level 3)

The Security Operations Training Centre is a 353‑sqm facility that prepares trainees for real-world security roles through immersive, command-based training. Designed around a 360-degree learning approach, it builds competencies in observation, decision-making, communication, and operational response—bridging classroom learning with practical application.

The Centre features specialised zones including a Command Centre with simulated monitoring systems, an MR/AI Zone for scenario-based training, and spaces for emergency drills, interviews, and border control simulations developed with ICA. Together, these environments strengthen situational awareness, teamwork, and professional judgement, equipping trainees to operate confidently in complex security settings.

Be the creative Craftsman with a real-world portfolio that you have always dreamed of. With a good and strong design foundation at the School of Design and Media, we will ensure you are on a great career and academic progression.

A niche School of ITE College Central, the School of Design & Media will equip you with practical, realistic and versatile design and media skills to put you in good stead to ride with the emerging trends and meet the changing needs of the Creative Industries.

## User Experience Hub (UX Hub)

### (Blk B Level 2)

The UX Hub is a high-tech immersive digital facility developed with support from seven industry partners. It focuses on User Experience, Immersive Media Production, and Business Intelligence, showcasing how digital technologies are transforming business, industry and content workflows.

The Hub comprises three zones: the Experience Gallery, featuring interactive displays such as video walls and projection mapping; the Production Studio, an industry-grade environment for multi-camera broadcast, live streaming and virtual production; and the Co-lab, a collaborative space where students and staff work with industry partners on real-world immersive media projects.

## Centre of Excellence in New Media

### (Blk K Level 2)

The Centre serves as a creative hub for animation, delivering specialised training in Core Animation and Core Visual Effects. It supports industry-aligned 2D and 3D production workflows, providing students with an authentic learning environment modelled after professional studios.

Students work in project teams with defined roles and responsibilities, mirroring real-world production practices and preparing them for careers in the animation and media industry

## Soundstage

### (Blk K Level 2)

The ITE Soundstage is a 400 sqm, double-height, soundproof facility designed for dialogue recording, film, and television production. It is equipped with high-capacity power supply, lighting fly-bars, DMX lighting control, and a large green screen to support virtual production and visual effects work.

The facility features movable room sets and an adjoining green room for talent preparation. It provides an authentic industry-style environment for training students in camera, lighting, and grip roles, while also supporting collaboration with industry partners on student and professional productions.

## The Cinema

### (Blk K Level 2)

The Cinema is a specialised video screening facility that doubles up as a mini lecture theatre that could accommodate 2 classes per session.

## Digital Imaging Studio

### (Blk K Level 5)

The studio, established in collaboration with Canon Singapore, supports training in digital imaging and demonstrates the full workflow from image capture to final output.

The facility features two dedicated spaces: a Digital Photography Studio for image capture, and an Image Editing Studio for processing and post-production. Together, they provide students with hands-on experience across the complete digital imaging process for various applications.

## Video Production Studio

### (Blk K Level 5)

ITE College Central’s Video Production Studio is a purpose-built facility that equips students with skills in multi-camera studio production. Students take on various studio crew roles, gaining hands-on experience in planning and executing productions. The studio features UHD broadcast cameras, a PTZ remote camera and LED lighting on an overhead grid and supports live streaming to platforms such as Facebook.

Designed as a flexible, multi-functional space, the studio also supports training in location and single-camera production. Modular stage components allow quick reconfiguration to meet diverse production needs.

## The Blackbox

### (Blk A Level 2)

The Blackbox is the primary training facility for technical theatre, providing students with an authentic environment to plan and stage productions. It features an automated lighting grid, mobile seating bleachers, and flexible lighting and sound systems that can be configured to suit diverse production needs.

Students complete two major projects annually—the First-Year Project and the Graduating Final-Year Project. In collaboration with ITE CEMTA, productions are staged at the Blackbox, offering students hands-on experience as production crew in live theatre settings.

## Design Experience Studio - Under Renovation

### (Blk B Level 3)

The Design Experience Studio supports an end-to-end learning and production workflow across four integrated areas: Digital Skills, Production, Experiential Retail and Flexible Pedagogy. Students gain hands-on experience with industry-relevant tools and equipment, including large format printers, vinyl cutters and flatbed plotters, alongside practical training in retail design and display across sectors such as apparel, FMCG, and beauty.

Designed to mirror real-world environments, the studio features dedicated spaces for retail planning, window displays, pop-up stores and project showcases. Flexible layouts and modular furniture allow seamless transitions between collaborative, instructional and production settings, enabling students to apply skills in authentic, industry-reflective scenarios.

# School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology

Come and explore the key facilities at our School of Electronics and Info-Comm Technology and be part of the vibrant electronics and ICT community.

Last updated 6 July 2026

Gaming, experimenting, exploring. If you are looking for fun and experimental ways of learning, our School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology is the right choice for you.

Through the adoption of the Play. Learn. Build teaching and learning model, the School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology provides you with opportunities to be that dynamic learner and problem-solver in finding real-world solutions through gaming and exploratory means. Hone your skills and technical knowledge in electronics systems and tools, and the working of new technologies for an exciting career with the electronics and ICT Industry.

## Cyber Security Intelligence Centre (CSi)

### (Blk C Level 5)

The Centre provides cyber range training and customised cybersecurity courses using realistic attack scenarios. It equips ITE students and the public with practical skills in cyber threat intelligence and incident response. Learners from all three ITE colleges can access the facility remotely or on-site, offering flexible, immersive and hands-on learning experiences.

Designed to replicate a real-world Security Operations Centre (SOC), the facility is supported by industry partner ST Engineering, ensuring training remains aligned with current industry practices and technologies.

## Microelectronics Training Centre

### (Blk J Level 2)

The Centre offers an authentic training environment equipped with semiconductor processing equipment, metrology tools, and automation systems, supporting hands-on learning in wafer fabrication, testing, and failure analysis. IoT-enabled sensors and automated systems enhance learning through remote monitoring and real-time insights.

Designed for 6-inch wafer fabrication, the facility also allows for future upgrades to 8-inch capabilities, ensuring relevance to evolving industry needs.

## IoT Experiential Centre

### (Blk C Level 5)

The IoT Experiential Centre is an industry-aligned “living lab” that bridges academic learning with real-world Internet of Things (IoT) applications. It supports students from the Higher Nitec in Electronics Engineering and Work-Study Diploma in IoT & Data Engineering programmes through hands-on training in a simulated, practice-based environment.

The Centre replicates key sectors such as retail, building, water and transport management, enabling students to deploy IoT systems—from sensor installation and calibration to data communication, visualisation and alert management. This immersive experience builds practical skills in using real-time data for decision-making, preparing graduates to contribute to Singapore’s smart ecosystem and drive productivity and efficiency.

## SME@AITE (AI Centre of Excellence)

### (Blk C Level 2)

SME@AITE (AI Centre of Excellence), jointly established with the Association of Small & Medium Enterprises (ASME), transforms the former UOX Centre into a live innovation platform focused on accelerating AI adoption and deployment for SMEs. It operates via a structured end-to-end model—Prototype, Deploy and Scale—where students and SMEs co-develop proof-of-concept solutions, extend them into real-world applications through internships, and scale viable solutions with technology partners.

This approach shifts the focus from demonstration to implementation, positioning ITE as a trusted enabler of SME digital transformation. Students gain hands-on experience with real business challenges, while SMEs benefit from a low-risk pathway to test and adopt AI solutions. Technology partners are also engaged to validate and expand solutions, creating a collaborative ecosystem that drives innovation and industry-ready outcomes.

# School of Engineering

Come and explore the key facilities at our School of Engineering.

Last updated 6 July 2026

If you are empowered by innovation and excited to discover possibilities through inventions, the School of Engineering is for you. Our School of Engineering provides progressive programmes that are relevant to the changing needs of the industry. The effective hands-on training and robust industrial attachment experience both locally and abroad, will equip you with the skills set and real work experience to set you ready for a career in engineering services and manufacturing related industries.

## Aviation Hub

### (Blk G Level 2)

The Aviation Hub provides an authentic training environment for hands-on learning in aircraft maintenance and repair. Students work with both military and civil aircraft, including the Bell UH-1H helicopter, S211 jet trainer, Learjet 24B, and Boeing 737, while gaining experience with industry-standard engines such as the JT9D turbofan and JT8 jet engines.

Enhanced by the Onboarding@SKILL facility developed with ST Engineering, students are introduced to industry-aligned Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) workflows, including inspection, planning, and reassembly using digital tools and automation.

Through real-world training and strong industry partnerships, students develop practical skills, gain internship and mentorship opportunities, and graduate well-prepared for careers in the aerospace industry.

## Robotics Lab

### (Blk E Level 2)

The Robotics Lab provides hands-on training in collaborative and mobile robotics, Autonomous Intelligent Vehicles (AIV), smart sensors, vision systems, and 3D printing. Students gain practical experience in setting up, operating, and maintaining modern robotic systems used in service robotics and advanced manufacturing.

Through applied learning in robotic mechanisms, sensing, and control, students develop skills for roles such as Robot Technician and Assistant Automation Engineer. Learning is further enriched through industry collaborations, including partnerships with Universal Robots to host the Human-Robot Collaboration Competition, where students showcase solutions that enhance sustainability, efficiency, and productivity in real-world applications.

## Automation Hub

### (Blk E Level 5)

The Automation Hub offers hands-on training in robotics programming, pneumatics and hydraulics, automation maintenance, and electrical installations. It is continuously updated to keep pace with Industry 4.0 developments, SkillsFuture initiatives, and evolving industry needs.

In collaboration with industry leaders such as ABB and Festo, as well as government agencies, ITE co-develops curricula that prepare both full-time students and adult learners with relevant technical skills. Emerging technologies, including Cyber-Physical Systems and Digital Twins, are progressively integrated to support the curriculum, ensuring training remains current, practical, and aligned with industry demands.

## Smart Manufacturing Hub

### (Blk E Level 2)

The Smart Manufacturing Hub is a living laboratory that provides authentic hands-on learning for students and serves as a Proof of Concept (POC) platform for industry partners. It showcases an Industry 4.0 environment with robotics, smart sensors and automated processes, supported by an advanced SCADA system for secure, remote monitoring and control of shop-floor operations.

Leveraging technologies such as cloud computing, machine-to-machine communication, data analytics and artificial intelligence, the hub enables process optimisation, predictive maintenance and efficient workflow management - enhancing overall equipment effectiveness in a smart manufacturing setting.

## Maritime Hub

### (Blk H Level 2)

The Maritime Hub houses the Maritime Training Centre, providing hands-on training in Marine and Offshore Engineering. It also features the ITE–Seatrium Digital Learning Lab, where students develop core skills in marine sustainability and digitalisation in a focused, industry-relevant environment.

Students and visitors can experience a realistic shipboard setting through a full-scale marine machinery space, alongside advanced training tools such as a Full Mission Marine Engine Simulator. The Hub also integrates sustainability-driven technologies, including robotic welding and an Electric Marine Vessel (EMV) training model, preparing students for future-ready maritime careers.

## Advanced Manufacturing Hub

### (Blk G Level 2)

The Advanced Manufacturing Hub at ITE College Central provides an industry aligned learning environment for high value and precision manufacturing. Through hands-on training, students develop practical skills in machining, forming, automation, quality assurance and data driven manufacturing, preparing them for sectors such as aerospace, precision engineering and medical technology.

Equipped with industry standard systems, the Hub features CNC laser cutting, bending and high-speed machining centres, supported by tool management technologies. Smart manufacturing capabilities include OEE dashboards, energy monitoring and AI‑enabled analytics, enabling students to track performance and productivity. Digital measurement tools, a Quality Management System, and Autonomous Mobile Robots further enhance learning in quality assurance and intelligent materials handling.

# Student Development / CCA

Join an exciting CCA at ITE College Central!

Last updated 21 May 2026

## Global Citizenship

### Overseas Exposure Programme (OEP)

The Overseas Exposure Programm (OEP) under the Global Citizenship track, seeks to provide students with exciting opportunities to develop a global perspective and acquire the necessary competencies and life skills through overseas experience. The holistic and quality global education experience prepares our students to be ‘world-ready’ graduates with the skillsets for today’s international and multicultural environments.

4 Overseas Experiential Programmes
- **Overseas Industrial Attachment Programme (OIAP)**Under the OIAP, students are attached to companies for a short working stint to expose them to work in different cultures and environment, and enhance their readiness to work upon graduation.
- **Overseas Student Exchange Programme (OSEP)**The OSEP opens opportunities for students to attend classes in overseas institutions and earn credits towards their certification.
- **Overseas Services & Development Programme (OSDP) – Community Service**The OSDP Community Service provides students with skills-building opportunities through volunteer work. Students undertake community service projects and learn to problem solve as compassionate global citizens.
- **Overseas Services & Development Programme (OSDP) – Development**Exposure under the OSDP – Development opens doors for students to take part in overseas competitions, seminars, conferences and leadership programmes to hone their skills, competencies and character.

Embark on a boundless journey of self-discovery at ITE College Central. Join the vibrant and dynamic college life!

Be it releasing your creative juices, unleashing your inner talent, developing your potential or simply to pique an interest in a new area, there are plenty of opportunities that await you.

Choose from over 90 CCAs from 7 development tracks - Arts, Community Service, Environment, Global Citizenship, Innovation & Enterprise, Leadership, Personal Development and Sports.

#### Our CCA success stories

Find out more about how being in a CCA helps develop you as a person and a leader through the  [stories of our alumni](/about-ite/colleges/college-central/student-development-and-cca/cca-success-stories/) !

They will work closely with the student counsellors in advocating for and creating a more caring and supportive school community.Note: Students interested can inform their Class Advisors or sign-up voluntarily during recruitment periods. More info can be found on our social media page.Follow us on Instagram:@iteccpeersupportleaders |
| Student Council | The Student Council represents the student body in the college and serves as a bridge between the students and College Management.We are keen to discover potential talents for the Student Council (SC) which provides personal development, exposure and training in leadership, as well as opportunities to serve and lead at school, college and even national events.Through the planning and organising of projects such as Anti-Drug awareness carnivals and sports meets, students can also further develop in character, communication and interpersonal skills. We cultivate your ideas and voice, forging friendships and serving others as we lead!Note: Applicants will require a recommendation by the Class Advisor, before undergoing a selection interview.Follow us on Instagram:@itecc_studentcouncil |
| Student Icons | We are a fun and interactive Student Leader CCA that specializes in reaching out to potential ITE students as well as members of the public through hosting secondary student visitors around the campus, and creating social media content for@itecollegecentralso that people will know the happenings and events of the school! This CCA gives us the opportunity to host and film videos during school events and post them on the College Central Instagram IGTV.We also attend leadership workshops, have exposure to nation-wide events like National Day Rally / Investiture, volunteer at overseas YEP projects and also have fun team bonding sessions to places like Superpark or Rock Climbing! In addition, we work closely with the other leadership CCAs like Student Council and Bridge Leaders for events and activities.Through this CCA, you can make new friends and expand your social circles, network with other student leaders and gain leadership skills like problem-solving, communication skills and boost your confidence!Follow us on Instagram:@iteccstudenticons |

They will have the opportunity to learn about designing and producing blaster and accessories in the areas of electronic and mechanical structures.This club will participate in local marksmanship competitions and organize team bonding games.Follow us on Instagram:@blasterlabcc |

It offers a diverse range of fun experiences, from adventure expeditions to leadership development, as well as community service. The ITE Central PRIMERS is open to all MALEs & FEMALEs, ages 17 to 20, first CCA, with or without BB background.Our ITECC Primers programme will include the following activities throughout your 2 to 3 years with us;Our very own Bagpipe & Drum Band,Boys Brigade Share-a-gift (Community service in December),Primers Challenge Adventure Camp (4days, 3nights @ Malaysia) or other Adventure based activities,Happy Children, Happy Future (Community Service),NYAA Gold, President's Award & Anchor Award related activities,Leadership positions & opportunities, & many more!Follow us on Instagram:@iteccprimers |

To provide students with leadership opportunities to confidently create and plan engaging events for target groups.Some of the signature internal events include a leadership programme known as EVM Gems, as well as a Youth Clash Tournament, bringing more than 160 students together for a day of bonding and fun. These events are held on an annual basis, providing leadership and volunteer management opportunities.The Club also has a series of community events under the 'EVM Cares' section, where we provide volunteering activities for students to create and plan engaging activities for target groups. Some of the activities include sing-a-long sessions, games, arts and craft activities.Through established partnerships, EVM Club also collaborates with valued industry partners in providing opportunities for students to gain experience and exposure to the event industry.Follow us on Instagram:@evm.club |

| Foosball | Foosball, also known as table soccer, is an awesome game of skill, speed, strategy and fun.Follow us on Instagram:@iteccfoosball |

We have three divisions, focusing on different aspects of the culture: Culture, Cosplay and Manga.The Culture division focuses on almost any Japanese related topics you can think of, from food, to history, to even anime!In the Cosplay division, you will learn how to do make-up, fix broken props and how to do adjustments to your cosplays.The Manga division offers you the chance to learn about a myriad of styles and techniques, and basic knowledge to get you started on drawing!Follow us on Instagram:@ite_jpcrc |

There is something for everyone!The varied duties available to a student-librarian allow each student to find his or her skill sets. The Library Club also trains student-librarians in information literacy, an important skill set which will benefit them throughout their lives.Follow us on Instagram:@ite_librarycentral |

Members of the club will learn the fundamentals of mechanical keyboard construction including the PCB, keyboard case, mechanical key switches and keycaps using tools. (e.g. soldering kits, lubricant)The MK Club aims to instill a spirit of exploration via tinkering, making and breaking apart things. Keyboards are inexpensive and familiar electronic devices to figure out how the mechanical and electrical components work together.Apart from hardware tinkering, members can also apply their creativity to create unique designs for mechanical keyboards. On the software programming side, mechanical keyboards can also be customized using scripts and macros.The club also provides an avenue for members to meet and share news on mechanical keyboard product development. |

Members will be able to render first aid for injuries sustained at the workplace or at home. Students will be able to perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and other emergency first aid measures in life-threatening situations. Our members were actively involved in the internal events in ITE campuses as well as external events. |

The club fosters a dynamic and inclusive community, equipping students with a platform for skill building to contribute to their respective schools and communities.TSC will provide hands-on sewing and fashion design workshops, enabling students to learn and improve their hands on and designing skills.TSC promotes awareness of sustainability through collaboration on projects that involve repurposing clothing and textiles.TSC fosters a sense of community by bringing together students who share a passion for fashion and sewing, creating a supportive and inclusive environment.Follow us on Instagram:@thesewcialclubitecc |

The Yoga Club provides an approachable indoor physical activity for students of varying fitness levels.Follow us on Instagram:@iteccyogaclub |

# CCA success stories

Find out more about how being in a CCA helps develop you as a person and a leader through the stories of our alumni!

Last updated 27 August 2025

## Leadership: Building self-confidence and learning how to lead in a team

**Aaron Chin**

- Student Council President 2019/20
- Valedictorian & Outstanding Graduate (School of Electronics & Infocomm Technology, 2021)
- Lee Kuan Yew Model Student Award
- Entering Ngee Ann Polytechnic, Diploma in Common ICT

Student Council (SC) has given me the opportunity to lead not only on an event level, but as the president of the student council. It has open my eyes to *understand the different needs and working styles* people have when leading.

I found myself developing from a follower to a *confident leader*, through the many events like Annual Council Sports Meet, where I was first appointed as the Overall i/c. Being given such a large role as a member was quite stressful, but I managed to pull through and it was fun creating a Sports day for the whole council.

Being in Student Council has made me more *open minded* and it has helped me to understand others better and to be more comfortable working with others

I have built the*confidence to speak to anyone* in public and be more *people oriented* compared to being more focused on myself or on the task or the process.

I also got to truly understand the need for a family, and what this means as part of a council.

I used to not understand the meaning of TEAM till working with my Exco's in SC. Before joining SC, I thought a team just meant - spreading and dividing the work load, so it was not so stressful for one person.

However, I found that it means *‘Together, Every, Action, Matters’*.

## Arts: Challenging oneself to pursue one's Passion

**Muhamad Zamri ​​​​​​​**

- Urban Central Statements President 2016/7
- ITE Arts Excellence Award
- Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts Dip. in Fashion Design Graduate
- Hip Hop Dance instructor @ Danz People

Being in Urban Central Statements (UCS) kicked start my *passion* in dance and allowed me to *take risks* with *challenging myself* in choreographing for events/competitions. even on a National platform like Super24. I feel like it built my foundation in evolving my choice of movements, when I now choreograph for classes.

I was inspired to teach by my coaches Muhd Zaihar and Ah Lee from O School. The opportunity to choreography items for shows like CCA Roadshow and ITE Emblazon sparked my interest to teach as part of my career.

Leading UCS has definitely helped me learn to *better engage* with my peers and has given me a good platform to learn from others and share my craft to my members. I carry this attitude with me now to share with the world what I’m passionate about - Dance!

## Leadership & Community Service: Developing the motivation to Lead and Serve

**Tan Chung Hao**

- Student Council president 2017/18
- Valedictorian & Outstanding Graduate (School of Engineering, 2019)
- Lee Kuan Yew Model Student Award
- Tay Eng Soon Gold Award
- Chairman of Yio Chu Kang Youth Network (2019 - current)

Student Council and the Community Service Club played a huge part in shaping me into the person I am today. This is also when I found my passion in *serving the community*as I was often involved in community service work. When I was interacting with the elderly, I felt more *open in communicating* with others and I can just talk freely. I realized after a few visits to various Senior Activity Centre (e.g. Lion Befrienders and AWWA), the elderly just want someone to talk to and do some activities together them.

Being appointed the President of Student Councilallowed me to *step out of my comfort zone*and greatly boosted my leadership and engagement skills. I realized by being a leader, I can do so much more for the community. I was further inspired by successful peers and grassroots leaders I met in my second year of Higher Nitec, to join the Youth Network (YN) at Yio Chu Kang Community Centre. Engaging in YN activities gives me a *great sense of fulfilment* and *motivates*me as I continue to lead and serve as Chairman the team.

# About College East

Welcome to ITE College East: where innovation meets learning.

Last updated 27 August 2025

At ITE College East, students receive training that is not only relevant to industries but also encourages innovation and enterprise. Our college is dedicated to helping you develop the skills and spirit of excellence needed to succeed in today's world. Here, you will find a supportive environment that inspires you to explore new ideas and personal growth.

## Explore our unique and practical programmes

ITE College East encompasses four exciting schools: Business & Services, Electronics & Info-comm Technology, Engineering, and the exclusive Health Sciences. Each school offers courses that teach real-world skills, preparing you for a successful career. Our programmes are designed to give you the knowledge and experience needed to achieve your dreams.

- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/CollegeEast/)

# Important information for graduands (ITE College East)

Congratulations on your graduation! Please help us make your graduation ceremony a success by observing the instructions below.

[Register for Graduation Ceremony](https://for.edu.sg/cegcregistration)

Last updated 9 June 2026

***Registration for the Graduation Ceremony will start on 14 April 2026 at 12pm and close on 23 April 2026******at 11.59pm.***

## Online registration

Each graduand will **be allowed to bring along 2 registered guests** to attend the ceremony. Prior registration via the  [Graduation Ceremony registration site](https://for.edu.sg/cegcregistration)  will be required for seating and logistical arrangements. Graduands and guests who did not register via the registration site will be deemed as ‘Not attending’ and turned away.

- All graduands are to register your attendance  [online](https://for.edu.sg/cegcregistration)  by Thu, 23 Apr 2026, 11.59pm.
- A confirmation page will be displayed and a confirmation email will be sent upon successful registration. Please screenshot the confirmation page for your own reference.

## Timeline of events

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Where do I register and how do I login?
Register your attendance on the  [registration portal](https://for.edu.sg/cegcregistration)  by **Thu, 23 Apr 2026, 11.59pm**. You may refer to the invitation sent to your ITE email (for full-time graduates) or your personal email (for part-time / WSDIP graduates) registered with ITE, for the login details.A One-Time Pin (OTP) will be sent to your email address for login during registration. Full-time graduands who have forgotten their password can visit  [https://www.ite.edu.sg/e-services-and-forms](/e-services-and-forms/)  and navigate to "**Student Password Reset**". Unregistered graduands and guests will be considered as not attending, and seats will not be reserved for them.Why am I only allowed to bring 2 registered guests to my graduation ceremony?
As we have limited seating capacity at our venue, graduands are only allowed to bring along 2 registered guests for the ceremony. Do register your attendance on the  [registration portal](https://for.edu.sg/cegcregistration)  by **Thu, 23 Apr 2026**. Unregistered graduands and guests are deemed as not attending and will not have seats reserved for them.What do I and my guests need to bring along for entry on event day?
Graduates are to bring along a photo identification for registration and collection of certificates (e.g. NRIC, FIN, Passport).**Attendees who also fail to bring their relevant identification or documents will not be able to collect their certificates.**Can I attend the graduation ceremony if I do not have the graduation attire?
All graduands must be in their graduation attire before they can be allowed on stage.

Full-Time National Servicemen (NSF) are also expected to change into the recommended outfit.I require a letter of excuse.
Graduands may use the email invitation as a proof of invite.I have registered my attendance online and would like to amend my submission. What should I do?
Please fill up the  [enquiry form](https://for.edu.sg/cegc-enquiry)  for us to amend your online registration before the online registration ends on **Thu, 23 Apr 2026, 11.59pm**.

To facilitate seating and logistics planning, we kindly request your understanding that no further amendment requests can be accommodated after the closing date.What happens if I do not pre-register online by Thu, 23 Apr 2026?
Only graduands and their guests who have pre-registered by the closing date will be admitted into the venues.Can I collect my certificate before the graduation ceremony?
No, all graduands will collect their certificate only after the graduation ceremony.Will there be an official photographer to take photographs of the graduands?
A professional photographer will take a photograph of you when you go on stage to receive your certificate. Soft copy of the stage photograph will be made available to you, a day after the ceremony via a website. Details will be made known at the ceremony. The College will not be responsible for any damaged photographs.

Our photographers will be taking photos at this event. The pictures may be used in various communications platforms, including but not limited to publications, ITE website, Corporate Newsletter and Facebook page.If I am unable to attend the graduation ceremony, can I get my friend to collect the certificate for me at the ceremony?
No. Graduands who are unable to attend the ceremony may contact the ITE College East Customer & Visitor Centre at 6590 2262 to make appointment to collect your certificate and transcript from **Mon, 25 May 2026** onwards. Please bring along your NRIC for verification purposes.Certificates which are uncollected will be destroyed after 1 year from the date of issuance and will not be re-issued.Can I collect my certificate if I have unpaid fees?
No, you will not be able to collect your certificate after the graduation ceremony if you have any unpaid fees. Please ensure that you have cleared all fees and loans prior to the Graduation Ceremony.

# School of Health Sciences

Discover your future in healthcare at our School of Health Sciences.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**Discover your future in healthcare at our School of Health Sciences.**

Are you passionate about helping others and making a difference in the lives of others? Our programmes are designed to give you hands-on experience and the skills needed to thrive in today's healthcare industry.

**Learn and grow in modern healthcare facilities**

At our School of Health Sciences, we are dedicated to training the healthcare professionals of tomorrow. With top-notch facilities and expert teachers, you will gain the knowledge to face healthcare challenges confidently. Start your journey towards a rewarding career in healthcare by exploring the exciting opportunities available at our college!

## Experience real-life training at the Community Care Training Centre

### (Business Blk, Level 1)

Our Community Care Training Centre offers a unique learning experience for students interested in the provision of care and support services. It is designed to look and feel like real nursing homes and rehabilitation centres. This realistic setting helps students understand what it is like to work in the community care field.

### Hands-on learning in a realistic environment

The centre includes facilities like a ward, assisted bath, and special needs areas, all with age-appropriate furniture. Students also have access to a pantry, dining area, and a special corner for clients with dementia. By practising skills in this authentic environment, students are well-prepared for their future roles as social service assistants.

## Step into realistic nursing at Our ITE Centre for Healthcare Simulation Training

### (Technology Blk, Level 6)

Our facility is designed to give students a realistic nursing experience. Using high-tech mannequins which can react to nursing care, students can practice their skills in a variety of medical situations. This helps them understand how to handle unexpected or critical events with confidence.

### Prepare for the future in a real-life environment

Students have the chance to experience medical events they may not see during hospital placements. This training helps them become better prepared to meet the needs of real patients. By learning in this advanced setting, students are ready for the challenges of a nursing career.

## Explore the world of eye care at the Opticianry Lab

### (Business Blk, Level 2)

The Opticianry Retail & Training Lab offers hands-on experience in a real optical retail setting. Students learn important skills like lens cutting, managing an optical shop, and basic eye testing. This training helps them understand what it is like to work as an optician.

### Gain real experience in eye-care services

Our lab is designed to look and feel like a real optical store, providing a realistic learning environment. Students face real-life situations and take part in different eye-care services. This prepares them for exciting careers in the primary eye-care industry.

## Other facilities

- Aspire Training Centre (Business Blk, Level 5)
- ITE Centre for Eyecare (Business Blk, Level 5)
- Paramedic Simulation Laboratory (Technology Blk, Level 6)

# School of Business & Services

Kickstart your career at the School of Business & Services.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**Kickstart your career at the School of Business & Services**

Ready to achieve your business aspirations? We offer special programmes in Business Services, Lifestyle, and Wellness. These courses help you develop a customer-focused mindset and an entrepreneurial spirit, boosting your confidence as a future professional.

**Explore exciting facilities for Hands-On Learning**

At our school, you will find amazing training facilities that bring learning to life. These spaces are designed to give you practical experience and prepare you for real-world challenges. With our support, you will be ready to shine in the business world.

## Experience aviation customer service at the Airport Premium Lounge

### (Business Blk, Level 1)

Our Airport Premium Lounge is designed for students to learn important skills in aviation customer service. Students in *Higher Nitec* in Passenger Services programme get to practise checking passengers' travel documents and understanding security measures. They also gain experience in lounge operations and serving beverages.

### Gain hands-on skills for a career in aviation

In our lounge, students learn through real-life scenarios, preparing them for the aviation industry. They explore various aspects of customer service, from security screenings to hospitality. This practical training helps them become skilled professionals in the world of aviation.

## Unlock your potential at the Beauty Therapy Training Centre

### (Business Blk, Level 1)

Our Beauty Therapy Training Centre is designed for students in the *Higher Nitec* in Beauty & Wellness Management course. It features three main studios: Nail & Make-up, Facial & Body Therapy, and Beauty & Wellness Spa. These spaces help students learn important beauty skills in a professional setting.

### Master beauty skills in our specialised studios

In our training centre, students gain hands-on experience in different beauty-related techniques. They practise everything from make-up and nail care, to spa treatments and body therapy. This practical learning prepares them for exciting careers in the beauty and wellness industry.

## Explore creativity at the Hair Spa & Design Centre

### (Business Blk, Level 1)

Our Hair Spa & Design Centre is tailored for students in the *Higher Nitec* in Hairdressing & Salon Management course. It includes five main studios: Hairstyling Studio 1, Hairstyling Studio 2, Chemical Treatment Studio, Hair Wash Studio, and Hair Spa. These studios provide a perfect space to learn and practise hairstyling techniques.

### Enhance your skills in specialised hair studios

In addition to the main studios, we offer three extra spaces: a Photography Studio, Consultation Area, and Hair Spa VIP Suite. These areas help students develop skills in client consultations and captures their creative work. The comprehensive training at our Centre prepares them for exciting careers in the beauty & personal care industry.

## Step into the future at the Logistics Technology Hub

### (Technology Blk, Level 1)

The Logistics Technology Hub is designed to train students in *Higher Nitec* and Work-Study Diploma logistics courses. It focuses on skills for warehouse automation, preparing future logistics professionals. Students learn about exciting technologies that are shaping the logistics industry.

### Discover cutting-edge technologies in logistics

At the hub, students explore hands-free wearables, automated systems, drones, IoT, collaborative robots, and data analytics. These tools help them understand how to improve supply chain productivity and efficiency. Through a mix of classroom learning and hands-on activities, students tackle real-world problems with innovative solutions.

## Immerse yourself in real-world training at the Wellness Centre

### (Business Blk, Level 1)

The Wellness Centre is a unique place where beauty therapy, hairdressing, and wellness management come together. Students get to work in a premium salon setting that uses advanced technology for learning. This experience helps them understand what it is like to serve real clients.

### Master beauty and hairdressing skills in our advanced facilities

Our centre offers a wide range of training facilities, including beauty therapy services, men's barbering, hair salon services, and a special lab for essential oil studies. Students practise in environments that look and feel like actual salons. This hands-on training prepares them for successful careers in the beauty and wellness industry.

## Other facilities

- Human Performance Laboratory (Business Blk, Level 3)
- Logistics Training Centre (Business Blk, Lower Ground)
- Airport Ops Simulation Training Centre (Business Blk, Level 2)
- Retail Training Lab (Business Blk, Level 1)

# School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology

Unlock your future in the School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology.

Last updated 27 August 2025

**Unlock your future in electronics and information technology**

Are you intrigued by electronic devices, new technologies, or cyber security? Our engaging courses will guide you through the exciting world of electronics and information technology.

**Experience innovative learning for career success**

Our school offers a vibrant training environment where you will learn creative problem-solving skills that are essential for lifelong learning. You will also gain industry-relevant abilities and a mindset that prepares you for a successful career in technology. Discover our state-of-the-art facilities and take the first step towards a bright future in the tech world!

## Discover the exciting world of Artificial Intelligence

### (Technology Blk, Level 4)

The AI Lab is designed to enhance your skills in artificial intelligence through a mix of courses, exciting projects, and enrichment programmes. We work closely with partners like Microsoft and AI Singapore to provide you with the best learning experience and discover new opportunities to develop your talents.

### Engage with innovative learning spaces

The AI Lab features two unique areas: the AI Museum and the AI Movie Theatre. The AI Museum showcases fascinating information about AI, inspiring you to dive deeper into the subject. Meanwhile, the AI Movie Theatre uses films as a fun way to teach important concepts, with a special focus on Generative AI skills to keep you up to date with the latest advancements in technology.

## Explore the future of technology at the Connectivity Solutions Laboratory

### (Technology Blk, Level 3)

The Connectivity Solutions Lab allows you to discover the exciting fields of the Internet of Things, Artificial Intelligence, and Automation. With its unique spaceship-inspired design, this lab offers hands-on training in electronic sensors and control systems, perfectly aligned with curriculum. Here, you will gain valuable skills in IoT, Communications, AI, and Automation.

### Engage in unique learning zones for real-world skills

The lab features several interactive zones to enhance your learning experience. In the Main Bridge & Observation Lounge, you will engage in classes equipped with smart lighting, while the Crew Quarters provides practical training in smart home device installation. Other areas, like the Cargo Bay and Engine Room, focus on logistics and sensor integration, ensuring you develop industry-relevant skills in a fun and innovative environment.

## Step into the Cyber Security Lab for an action-packed learning experience

### (Technology Blk, Level 4)

The Cyber Security Lab is a cutting-edge facility developed with support from industry leaders like Lumen Technologies, ReaQta, SecureAge, Toffs Technologies, and the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA). This lab is designed to enhance your studies in Cyber & Network Security and Forensics through advanced technology and real-world training opportunities. Here, you will gain valuable skills through hands-on experiences and internships that prepare you for a successful career in cyber security.

### Master essential skills in a realistic security environment

In the Cyber Security Lab, you will train in a setting that mimics a Security Operations Centre (SOC). This unique environment allows you to learn how to gather information, spot suspicious activities, and detect network issues effectively. By working on identifying vulnerabilities and threats, you will develop practical skills needed to face the challenges of the cyber security industry with confidence.

## Discover the Data Centre Lab for future-ready skills

### (Technology Blk, Level 4)

The Data Centre Lab is an exciting part of ITE’s Work-Study Diploma in Data Centre Infrastructure & Operation. Developed in partnership with industry leaders like Microsoft and Ecolab, this lab provides you with access to advanced technology and real-world training opportunities. Here, you will gain valuable skills through hands-on experiences and internships that prepare you for a successful career in data centre operations.

### Gain practical experience in a cutting-edge environment

In the Data Centre Lab, you will learn how to manage essential facilities and IT infrastructure. This includes important areas such as fire protection, electrical systems, air-conditioning, and network administration. As part of the ITE–Microsoft Data Centre Academy, you will receive specialised training that equips you with the skills needed for future roles in the fast-growing field of data centre operations.

## Unleash your creativity at the Go LIVE! Studio

### (Technology Blk, Level 5)

The Go LIVE! Studio is the perfect place to explore your creativity while learning about social media marketing. This exciting space allows you to work with industry partners and gain real-world experience in content creation. Here, you will discover how to make engaging videos and develop skills that are essential for today’s digital world.

### Master essential skills for social media success

In the Go LIVE! Studio, you will learn important skills for producing quality videos and understanding social media marketing. You will also work on projects, giving you hands-on experience in creating effective marketing content. By applying analytics, you will learn how to improve your outcomes and develop innovative ideas that stand out in the industry.

## Explore the Sustainability Lab for a greener future

### (Technology Blk, Level 3)

The Sustainability Lab offers you the chance to learn how to upgrade and refurbish PCs, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices. This hands-on experience not only helps you understand various IT devices but also promotes environmental sustainability. Through the hands-on learning in this lab, you will gain valuable skills that contribute to a greener planet.

### Develop essential skills for sustainable technology

In the Sustainability Lab, you will focus on important areas such as PC and laptop refurbishment, as well as, learn how to restore and enhance devices to extend their lifespan. You will also explore concepts related to sustainability and the circular economy, which include carbon management and eco-friendly practices. Additionally, the lab encourages critical thinking and problem-solving, ensuring you are well-equipped to tackle challenges in the field of technology and sustainability.

## Other facilities

List of other facilities in the School of Electronics & Info-Comm Technology
